method.random_sampling: without replacement within trial; key overlap allowed
method.low_selection: lowest frozen Task15 within_modality_importance; stable bin-index ties
method.primary_unit: paired sample x modality; Visual excludes all-zero in primary analysis
method.classification: original predicted class probability drop; signed
method.test: two-sided Wilcoxon, zero differences removed; rank-biserial effect
method.multiplicity: BH-FDR over 12 modality x task x comparison tests within split
method.bootstrap: 1000 paired sample resamples; percentile 95% CI of mean gap
method.interval: one frozen key interval at a time; auxiliary unadjusted Spearman

visual_baseline_sensitivity.baseline: sample structural-content modality mean in standardized space

protocol_lock.statistics: paired two-sided Wilcoxon, rank-biserial, 12-test BH-FDR, 1000 bootstrap

bootstrap_ci.definition: 95% percentile intervals in significance_tests for mean paired gap and means
